The '''sand skitter''' was a small, furry rodent-like creature native to the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was distinguishable for its four eyes; two on its head, and two additional eyes supported by eye stalks. Harmless and easily caught by a quick, long [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]], it was one of the favored preys of the [[Worrt/Legends|worrt]]. When under distress or frightened, they utter a high-pitched cry, similar to that of the [[Gorg/Legends|Gorgs]] or [[Klatooine paddy frog/Legends|Klatooine paddy frogs]].

==Behind the scenes==
The sand skitter was named by the Lucasfilm-sanctioned [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious B. Crumb]] Creature Pack - Inclusive Edition, by Sideshow Collectibles.
